description.zh: 从入口函数和标准输出开始，修改文本后再次运行。
description.en: Start with the entry function and standard output. Edit the message and run again.

description.zh: 观察默认不可变变量、常量和可变绑定。
description.en: Compare immutable bindings, constants, and mutable variables.

bindings.source:
@main

const MAX = 100

fn main() int {
    name := "Xu"
    mut age := 20
    age += 1
    println(name)
    println(age)
    println(MAX)
    << 0
}

description.zh: 整数运算、取余和比较表达式返回不同类型的值。
description.en: Try integer arithmetic, remainder, and boolean comparisons.

arithmetic.source:
@main

fn main() int {
    a := 17
    b := 5
    println(a + b)
    println(a - b)
    println(a * b)
    println(a / b)
    println(a % b)
    println(a > b)
    println(a == b)
    << 0
}

description.zh: 拼接字符串、输出中文，并将整数转换为字符串。
description.en: Concatenate strings, print Unicode text, and convert an integer to a string.

description.zh: 根据成绩选择分支；修改 score 查看不同结果。
description.en: Choose a branch based on a score. Change score to explore the results.

description.zh: 使用 start:end 区间匹配，区间包含起点、不包含终点。
description.en: Match a start:end range, including the start and excluding the end.

description.zh: 用 for 累加，用 while 倒数，观察两种循环。
description.en: Accumulate a sum with for and count down with while.

description.zh: 用 -> 跳过偶数，用 <- 在到达上限时退出循环。
description.en: Use -> to skip even values and <- to leave the loop at a limit.

description.zh: 声明带参数的函数，通过 << 返回计算结果。
description.en: Define a function with parameters and return a calculated value with <<.

description.zh: 递归函数需要终止条件；这里计算 6 的阶乘。
description.en: A recursive function needs a base case. This computes factorial of 6.

description.zh: 读取数组长度和索引，并用循环计算数组元素之和。
description.en: Read array length and an indexed value, then sum the elements.

description.zh: 枚举成员可以携带数据，match 可以拆解这些字段。
description.en: Enum variants can carry data, which match can destructure.

description.zh: 用结构体保存状态，通过 &mut 接收者修改它。
description.en: Store state in a struct and update it through an &mut receiver.

description.zh: 断言验证程序假设；将 25 改为其他值可观察失败诊断。
description.en: Check an assumption with assert. Change 25 to see a failure diagnostic.

description.zh: 这个示例会编译失败：在借用仍被使用时修改原值。删除 number = 9 后重新运行。
description.en: This intentionally fails: a value is changed while its borrow is still in use. Remove number = 9 and run again.

description.zh: 在一个程序中组合 if、match、while 和 for。
description.en: Combine if, match, while, and for in a single program.

description.zh: 容量为 2 的信道保存两个整数，接收后相加。
description.en: Store two integers in a channel with capacity 2, then receive and add them.

description.zh: 用 xu 启动三个协程，通过同一个信道收集结果。
description.en: Start three coroutines with xu and collect their results through one channel.

description.zh: 生产者发送数字，平方协程处理后送入输出信道。
description.en: A producer sends numbers to a coroutine that squares them and forwards the results.

description.zh: 通过 xu f() 语法启动轻量协程并发执行任务，借助 chan 信道收发数据并安全同步。
description.en: Launch lightweight coroutines using xu f() and synchronize results through a typed channel.

description.zh: Button、Checkbox、Switch、Slider 使用与桌面相同的 Xu widgets 源码。点击或用 Tab 聚焦，Enter/空格激活；滑块支持方向键。Esc 离开画布。
description.en: Button, Checkbox, Switch, and Slider run the same Xu widgets source as desktop. Click or Tab to focus; Enter/Space activates. Arrow keys adjust the slider. Esc leaves the canvas.

description.zh: 三页真实桌面控件：基础交互、ListBox / Scroll、Label / Card / Badge / Progress 与只读 Editor。点击页签或 Tab 聚焦后用方向键切换；列表和滚动区域支持滚轮。
description.en: Three pages of shared desktop controls: basics, ListBox / Scroll, and Label / Card / Badge / Progress with a display-only Editor. Click tabs or focus with Tab and use arrows; wheel scrolls lists and content.

ui-gallery.source:
@main
#ui
#ui/draw
#ui/layout
#ui/widgets
#playground

fn box(x f64,y f64,w f64,h f64) layout.Rect {
    << layout.Rect{x: x,y: y,width: w,height: h}
}
fn labels(context &draw.Context,values []string) []draw.TextLayout {
    options := draw.text_options(15.0)
    mut result := []draw.TextLayout{}
    for value in values { shaped := context.layout_text(&value,&options) or >>
        result.push(shaped) }
    << result
}
fn demo() int {
    identity := playground.canvas_identity()
    context := draw.default_context()
    theme := widgets.default_theme()
    styles := widgets.dark_styles()
    tab_labels := labels(&context,["Basics", "Data / Scroll", "Display"] ) or >>
    names := labels(&context,["Button +1", "Checkbox", "Switch", "Radio A", "Radio B"]) or >>
    button_label := names[0]
    check_label := names[1]
    switch_label := names[2]
    radio_a_label := names[3]
    radio_b_label := names[4]
    rows := labels(&context,["Array", "Map", "Struct", "Channel", "Ownership", "AOT", "WASM", "Native"]) or >>
    mut tabs := widgets.tabs(&identity,1,&box(20.0,44.0,600.0,38.0),3,0) or >>
    mut button := widgets.button(&identity,2,&box(32.0,106.0,158.0,38.0)) or >>
    mut check := widgets.checkbox(&identity,3,&box(32.0,160.0,240.0,32.0),false) or >>
    mut toggle := widgets.switch_control(&identity,4,&box(32.0,210.0,240.0,32.0),false) or >>
    mut slider := widgets.slider(&identity,5,&box(322.0,112.0,272.0,32.0),0.0,100.0,40.0) or >>
    slider.set_step(5.0) or >>
    mut radio_a := widgets.radio(&identity,6,&box(322.0,170.0,260.0,32.0),0,true) or >>
    mut radio_b := widgets.radio(&identity,7,&box(322.0,220.0,260.0,32.0),1,false) or >>
    mut list := widgets.list_box(&identity,8,&box(32.0,114.0,254.0,172.0),8,0) or >>
    mut scroll := widgets.scroll(&identity,9,&box(322.0,114.0,276.0,172.0),widgets.AXIS_VERTICAL,336.0) or >>
    card := widgets.card(&box(28.0,102.0,584.0,200.0)) or >>
    mut badge := widgets.badge(&box(478.0,116.0,110.0,30.0)) or >>
    badge.set_selected(true)
    badge_labels := labels(&context,["Shared Xu"]) or >>
    badge_label := badge_labels[0]
    mut title := widgets.styled_label(&context,&"Desktop control logic")
    mut editor := widgets.input(&context,&identity,10,&box(52.0,244.0,536.0,38.0),&"Read-only Editor / Xu ownership") or >>
    editor.set_read_only(true) or >>
    mut progress := widgets.progress(&box(52.0,208.0,164.0,18.0),0.4) or >>
    mut invalid_progress := widgets.progress(&box(238.0,208.0,164.0,18.0),0.4) or >>
    invalid_progress.set_invalid(true)
    mut disabled_progress := widgets.progress(&box(424.0,208.0,164.0,18.0),0.4) or >>
    disabled_progress.set_enabled(false)
    mut focus := widgets.focus_group(&identity,[1,2,3,4,5,6,7]) or >>
    mut applied_focus := 0
    mut count := 0
    mut selected := 0
    while true {
        input := playground.next_input()
        if input.kind == 0 { <- }
        old_page := tabs.selected()
        navigation := focus.input(&input)
        current := focus.current()
        if current != applied_focus {
            tabs.set_focus(current == 1)
            button.set_focus(current == 2)
            check.set_focus(current == 3)
            toggle.set_focus(current == 4)
            slider.set_focus(current == 5)
            radio_a.set_focus(current == 6)
            radio_b.set_focus(current == 7)
            list.set_focus(current == 8)
            scroll.set_focus(current == 9)
            applied_focus = current
        }
        if navigation.consumed { -> }
        action := tabs.input(&input)
        if action.request_focus { focus.focus(1) or >> }
        if tabs.selected() != old_page {
            if tabs.selected() == 0 { focus.set_items([1,2,3,4,5,6,7]) or >> }
            else if tabs.selected() == 1 { focus.set_items([1,8,9]) or >> }
            else { focus.set_items([1]) or >> }
            focus.focus(1) or >>
            button.cancel()
            toggle.cancel()
            slider.cancel()
            radio_a.cancel()
            radio_b.cancel()
            list.cancel()
            scroll.set_focus(false)
        } else if tabs.selected() == 0 {
            a := button.input(&input)
            b := check.input(&input)
            c := toggle.input(&input)
            d := slider.input(&input)
            e := radio_a.input(&input)
            f := radio_b.input(&input)
            if a.kind == widgets.ACTION_ACTIVATE { count += 1 }
            if e.kind == widgets.ACTION_CHANGE { selected = 0 }
            if f.kind == widgets.ACTION_CHANGE { selected = 1 }
            radio_a.set_value(selected == 0)
            radio_b.set_value(selected == 1)
            if a.request_focus { focus.focus(2) or >> }
            if b.request_focus { focus.focus(3) or >> }
            if c.request_focus { focus.focus(4) or >> }
            if d.request_focus { focus.focus(5) or >> }
            if e.request_focus { focus.focus(6) or >> }
            if f.request_focus { focus.focus(7) or >> }
        } else if tabs.selected() == 1 {
            a := list.input(&input) or >>
            _ := scroll.input(&input) or >>
            if a.request_focus { focus.focus(8) or >> }
            if input.kind == ui.EV_POINTER_DOWN && box(322.0,114.0,276.0,172.0).contains(input.x,input.y) { focus.focus(9) or >> }
        }
        current_after := focus.current()
        if current_after != applied_focus {
            tabs.set_focus(current_after == 1)
            button.set_focus(current_after == 2)
            check.set_focus(current_after == 3)
            toggle.set_focus(current_after == 4)
            slider.set_focus(current_after == 5)
            radio_a.set_focus(current_after == 6)
            radio_b.set_focus(current_after == 7)
            list.set_focus(current_after == 8)
            scroll.set_focus(current_after == 9)
            applied_focus = current_after
        }
    }
    progress.set_value(slider.value() / 100.0) or >>
    invalid_progress.set_value(slider.value() / 100.0) or >>
    disabled_progress.set_value(slider.value() / 100.0) or >>
    mut frame := context.new_frame(8192)
    frame.begin() or >>
    frame.clear(draw.rgb(16,24,39)) or >>
    draw.text(20,12,21,"#f8fafc","Xu / WASM control gallery")
    tabs.paint(mut &frame,&tab_labels,&theme) or >>
    if tabs.selected() == 0 {
        button.paint(mut &frame,&button_label,&theme) or >>
        check.paint(mut &frame,&check_label,&theme) or >>
        toggle.paint(mut &frame,&switch_label,&theme) or >>
        slider.paint(mut &frame,&theme) or >>
        radio_a.paint(mut &frame,&radio_a_label,&theme) or >>
        radio_b.paint(mut &frame,&radio_b_label,&theme) or >>
        draw.text(32,274,16,"#e2e8f0","Count: " + str(count) + "   Slider: " + str(int(slider.value())))
    } else if tabs.selected() == 1 {
        draw.text(32,90,14,"#94a3b8","ListBox: click / Up / Down / End")
        draw.text(322,90,14,"#94a3b8","Scroll: wheel / Tab + PageDown")
        list.paint(mut &frame,&rows,&theme) or >>
        scroll.begin(mut &frame) or >>
        for i in 0:8 {
            label := rows[i]
            frame.text_layout(&label,12.0,12.0 + f64(i) * 42.0,theme.foreground) or >>
        }
        scroll.end(mut &frame) or >>
    } else {
        card.paint(mut &frame,&theme) or >>
        title.paint_text_styled(mut &frame,&box(42.0,116.0,410.0,36.0),&styles,&styles.button,0) or >>
        badge.paint(mut &frame,&badge_label,&theme) or >>
        draw.text(52,174,15,"#94a3b8","Progress: normal / invalid / disabled (Basics slider)")
        progress.paint_styled(mut &frame,&styles) or >>
        invalid_progress.paint_styled(mut &frame,&styles) or >>
        disabled_progress.paint_styled(mut &frame,&styles) or >>
        frame.push() or >>
        frame.translate(52.0,244.0) or >>
        editor.paint(mut &frame,&theme) or >>
        frame.pop() or >>
    }
    draw.text(20,328,13,"#94a3b8","Tab / Shift+Tab: focus   Arrows: change tab or value   Esc: leave")
    frame.present() or >>
    println("Page: " + str(tabs.selected()) + " | Count: " + str(count) + " | Check: " + str(check.value()) + " | Switch: " + str(toggle.value()) + " | Slider: " + str(int(slider.value())) + " | Radio: " + str(selected) + " | List: " + str(list.selected()) + " | Scroll: " + str(int(scroll.offset())))
    << 0
}
fn main() int {
    << demo() or (err) { eprintln(err.msg())
        << 1 }
}
